question: Why did NYC yellow taxi trips drop on Thursday 28 Nov 2024 compared with the surrounding weeks?

calls.content:
{
  "sql": "SELECT trip_date,
       holiday_name,
       is_national
FROM   whybot.us_holidays
WHERE  trip_date IN (DATE '2024-11-28',
                     DATE '2024-11-21',
                     DATE '2024-11-14',
                     DATE '2024-11-07',
                     DATE '2024-10-31')
ORDER BY trip_date DESC",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.us_holidays"],
  "note": "Returns holiday info for 28 Nov 2024 and the three prior Thursdays so you can compare trip volume patterns against holiday presence."
}

{"sql":"SELECT holiday_date, holiday_name, is_national FROM whybot.us_holidays WHERE holiday_date IN (DATE '2024-11-28', DATE '2024-11-21', DATE '2024-11-14', DATE '2024-11-07', DATE '2024-10-31') ORDER BY holiday_date DESC","tables_used":["whybot.us_holidays"],"note":"Check holiday presence on the target date and three prior Thursdays"}

{"sql":"SELECT obs_date, prcp_mm, snow_mm, tmax_c, tmin_c FROM whybot.nyc_weather_daily WHERE obs_date IN (DATE '2024-11-28', DATE '2024-11-07', DATE '2024-11-14', DATE '2024-11-21') ORDER BY obs_date","tables_used":["whybot.nyc_weather_daily"],"note":"Fetch weather metrics for 28 Nov 2024 and three prior Thursdays to compare against the taxi trip drop."}

{"sql":"SELECT trip_date,
       avg_total_amount,
       avg_trip_distance,
       CASE WHEN trip_date = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN 'target' ELSE 'baseline' END AS period_type
FROM whybot.yellow_daily
WHERE dayofweek(trip_date) = 5
  AND trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-07' AND DATE '2024-12-05'
ORDER BY trip_date","tables_used":["whybot.yellow_daily"],"note":"Selects all Thursdays from 7 Nov to 5 Dec 2024, tags 28 Nov as target, orders chronologically. Uses dayofweek=5 for Thursday per Spark convention (1=Sunday..7=Saturday)."}

{"sql":"SELECT trip_date, trips, avg_total_amount, avg_trip_distance, 
 CASE WHEN trip_date = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_target_date 
 FROM whybot.yellow_daily 
 WHERE trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' 
 ORDER BY trip_date","tables_used":["whybot.yellow_daily"],"note":"Aggregated output under 200 rows. Validates data completeness for 2024-11-28 and surrounding Thursdays using conditional CASE flag."}
